elements.label: 'The Omniscience'
elements.description:
I could ask it any question, and the answers that appear on its pages have never been mistaken so far. However, once its creator is mentioned, the phrasing becomes peculiar: it sometimes claims to have been crafted by a shaper of history, sometimes foretells that this person will defeat my army head-on on the other side of the sea, and sometimes declares its own existence as the manifestation of a higher form of mercy. Perhaps it's best not to take this matter too seriously.

[A tutorial book. Combine it with any copy in Work to receive hints.]

slots.label: Question
slots.description: What do I wish to know?

elements.label: 'The Omniscience'(Static?)
elements.description: No new text appears on the page for now.

elements.label: Fissifer, Name-of-Steel
elements.description: The future Name-of-Steel, once a 120,000-ton self-propelled battleship, armed with deadly glass cannons and a fire-control system driven by Great technology. To be objective, Fissifer itself is merely an ordinary spirit; yet the perfect fusion of Invisible technology and cutting-edge materials enables it to wield power no less than that of any Long. This is the charm of engineering.

elements.label: Fissifer, Reloading
elements.description: Fissifer, while reloading the great cannon, is grumbling yet again about the issue with the dock.

elements.label: Wulfie, 'The Mournful Wolf'
elements.description: The sinners are constantly suffering from the pain inflicted by the Wolf. This mental burden often drives them into a state of madness where they are unable to communicate. But Wulfie knows how to endure...until the moment of final revenge arrives.

elements.label: Wulfie, Waned
elements.description: Wulfie's eyes lost their focus, icy tears welled up from her eyes, then froze upon her cheeks. The Wolf is whispering.

elements.label: Fr.Constantine, The Doorseeker
elements.description: One of the high-ranking members within the Church of the Unconquered Sun whose stance leans in my favor, a Secret Historian and an (unofficial) Illumination scholar. Most people only recognize him as a passionate and 'radiant' clergyman, yet that is merely the tip of the iceberg in his complex background.

elements.label: Constantine, Elsewhere
elements.description: Constantine's attention turned to glass, mirrors, and many more distant vessels... but he would soon return.

elements.label: Fiona, The Rose-Witch
elements.description: Perfumer, gardener and Grail-Long of the Flowermaker in the same time. Possesses an insatiable craving for pleasure, paired with a taste so exacting it seems to contradict it all—rumored to stem from a wretched romance in her mortal days. Not that I had any reason to pry further.

elements.label: Fiona, Secluded
elements.description: Fiona, intoxicated by the illusory yet delightful fragrance of flowers, with cheeks flushed rose-red — it would hardly be wise to disturb her now.

elements.label: Standard-issue Archaize Rifle
elements.description:
An archaize rifle crafted in Scotswood, incised with the fivefold mark of the Many-Winged Ones. Cutting-edge technology enables it to wield mundane ammunition with near-original potency—at the cost of exorbitant ammunition expense. Compromise is ever the way of the world.
[Load it by inserting both the weapon and alloy projectiles into Work. Notably, this weapon does not vanish even when its ammunition is depleted.]

elements.label: Standard-issue Archaize Rifle (Cooling Down)
elements.description: The heat in the chamber had yet to fade.

elements.label: Standard-issue Archaize Rifle
elements.description:
The chamber holds no rounds.
[A rifle only gains the Edge and Weapon aspects when loaded. Place it with Alloy Projectiles into Work to reload.]

elements.label: Furious Element
elements.description: Hokobald's final creation—though its maker's nature was depraved and pitiable, the device ceaselessly radiates violent light and heat, revealing the astonishing heights his potential could have reached.

elements.label: Furious Element (Cooling Down)
elements.description: Continuing to leave this object's radiation unchecked is dangerous—better wait a little longer before putting it to use.

elements.label: Pearl of Ebbing Tides
elements.description: This is likely all that remains of a fallen Name of the Tide... Perhaps she was once beautiful, perhaps once joyful, but all that has passed into history with that great upheaval. Now, only the instinct for survival persists—undignified and raw.

elements.label: Pearl of Ebbing Tides (Refreshing)
elements.description: It needs a bit more time to regain its usual brilliance.

elements.label: Feasting Grail
elements.description: You can drink it all in one go. Then, sooner or later, at some unexpected moment, it will refill itself with red wine - that from the Monastery of the Fifth Cup, the wine that brings about mistakes and folly.

elements.label: Feasting Grail (Empty)
elements.description: The grail is completely empty... It would be nice if it remained that way forever.

elements.label: Ingenious Key
elements.description: Most keys only know how to open, but this one knows how to seek.

elements.label: Ingenious Key (Exhausted)
elements.description: It will take some time to re-identify the right paths to open.

elements.label: Hammer of Glory
elements.description:
In their most resplendent era, the immortals of the Red Rose forged this weapon, certain their leader would wield it to conquer all of Europe. Ambition crumbled to dust, and the artifact was buried alongside its makers. Yet, if I can learn and surpass the limits of those who came before, perhaps it may still witness greater glory. 
[Place it together with Bitterblack Salts into Work to load and unleash its true power.]

elements.label: Hammer of Glory: Ignited!
elements.description: It trembles incessantly from the energy sealed within, while the air warps and shimmers under its hellish heat—a wild force, ready to be unleashed!

elements.label: Hammer of Glory (Cooling Down)
elements.description: Swinging this continuously is perilous even for me—patience is required until it cools.

elements.label: Ghoulish Shotgun
elements.description:
An insane yet highly efficient weapon, designed to complete a war that was destined to be lost. The war is over, its master is gone, but its hunger remains unsatisfied. Still tirelessly devours the pain and hatred of the deceased.
[Place it together with Remnant into 'Work', you could load it and unleash its true power.]

elements.label: Ghoulish Shotgun, Revived
elements.description: The agonizing shriek of life's ebbing away is trapped in the barrel, waiting to be released.

elements.label: Ghoulish Shotgun, Awaken
elements.description: The agonizing shriek of life's ebbing away is trapped in the barrel, waiting to be released.

elements.label: Ghoulish Shotgun (Preparing)
elements.description: Its hunger has temporarily faded. Temporarily.

elements.label: Ghoulish Shotgun (Preparing)
elements.description: Its hunger has temporarily faded. Temporarily.

elements.label: Monster Hunters' Dart
elements.description:
A poison-tip throwing weapon, used by the Colonel's servants for hunting monsters and other supernatural beings; of course, the one I have is a slightly modified replica - no reason to provoke the wrath of the Scarred over this.
[This weapon can be obtained repeatedly, but each one can only be used once.]

elements.label: Savage Tooth
elements.description:
The most lethal part of a monster, sharp and hot, capable of easily breaking through armor and the protection of low-level spells just like piercing through thin paper.
[This weapon can be obtained repeatedly, but each one can only be used once.]

elements.label: Support From Royalists
elements.description: Nobles, bureaucrats, and members of secret societies—my loyal followers. I may call upon them to aid in my goals or command them to gather resources for me, yet the patience of mortals is ever finite.

elements.label: Support From the Army
elements.description: A mundane unit armed with light firearms.

elements.label: Divine Metal
elements.description: These are the main products of the glassworks beyond conductors and machinery. Not only are they hard and scorching, but saturated with condensed brilliance within, and bound with so many suppressed souls that they could bear the body of a god—yet regrettably, finding a forge suitable for shaping them has now become a distant hope.

elements.label: Divine Metal (Exhausted)
elements.description: I must wait a while before I can harness the power stored within these intricate artifacts again.

elements.label: Forging Spark
elements.description: A bright spark that separated from the heart of the Forge, now imprisoned within the cage of steel and light, at my disposal.

elements.label: Forging Spark (Dim)
elements.description: Its heat is gradually returning over time.

elements.label: Excrucis
elements.description:
Divided, cursed, harmed - holding this object will allow you to feel the pain that has persisted for a hundred years among the sun and its companions; waving this object can pierce the sinuous thorns of evil into the soul of every perpetrator. All these imposed sufferings will be returned a hundredfold.
[Using this weapon in any way might generate a 'Agonizing Wound'.]

elements.label: Excrucis (Dim)
elements.description: The searing pain piercing deep into the soul lessened somewhat, but it was certain to last only for a short while. Before all the sins were atoned for, this thing would never forget or forgive.

elements.label: Laevatain
elements.description:
A sacred artifact forged by the fire of the Chandler, filled with the power of paradox and time. It symbolizes the inevitable arrival of the Chandler and the ensuing eternal dusk.
[Using this weapon in any way might generate a 'Shadow of Laevatain'.]

elements.label: Laevatain (Dim)
elements.description: The amazing and contradictory power is being reawakened.

elements.label: Shadow of Laevatain
elements.description:
The flame of the candle is fierce, yet its shadow is icy cold.
[Will turn into a 'Husk' if used. In particular, this card cannot have its duration refreshed through 'Work'.]

elements.label: Dawn Megaton (Full Power)
elements.description: Each discharge is an artificial dawn: rocks and soil will turn into glass, while flesh and blood transform into radiance. How charming.

elements.label: Dawn Megaton (Charging)
elements.description: A complex and precise killing machine, its movement would cause the earth to tremble, while its vibration harmonious as an orchestra. To anyone who still believes that grandeur and elegance cannot coexist, let him listen to its deadly melody himself.

elements.label: Dawn Megaton (Calibrating)
elements.description: Engines restarts to cool down, lens adjusted to specific angles, and the pipes are orderly transporting the most intense energy - all of this is done without human intervention, but by the spiritual flames themselves.

elements.label: Immortal Guards, Shaping Hands
elements.description: Brute and scorching power is poised.

elements.label: Immortal Guards, Shaping Hands (Charging)
elements.description: A body of an immortal was once again awakened and infused with savage combat skills. It is stronger and more lethal than before, and is now loyal to a better master.

elements.label: Immortal Guards, Shaping Hands (Preparing)
elements.description: The immortal guards are making the necessary preparations.

elements.label: Immortal Guards, Dreadful Hands
elements.description: The wisdom of resilience and conclusion awaits.

elements.label: Immortal Guards, Dreadful Hands (Charging)
elements.description: A body of an immortal was once again awakened and infused with cunning combat skills. It is stronger and more lethal than before, and is now loyal to a better master.

elements.label: Immortal Guards, Dreadful Hands (Preparing)
elements.description: The immortal guards are making the necessary preparations.

elements.label: Fissifer the Omen, Shaping Hands
elements.description: Fissifer will stir up a merciless upheaval with a hellish heat.

elements.label: Fissifer the Omen, Dreadful Hands
elements.description: Fissifer will destroy failed creations with the icy coldness like a sharp knife.

elements.label: Fissifer the Omen (Charging)
elements.description: An Name not yet apparent, a harbinger of a great era, a flicker of an invisible but already sufficiently intense flame - Fissifer has been permanently transformed, and his potential goes far beyond this.

elements.label: Fissifer the Omen (Rekindling)
elements.description: The flames of Fissifer are becoming increasingly intense and bright.

elements.label: Fissifer the Omen (Recovering)
elements.description: Fissifer's flames temporarily weakened, but he will not come to an end just because of this.

elements.label: Fissifer, The Pioneer of Steel
elements.description: 'Forged with divinity, blade as the key - we shall transcend the end decreed by the gods.'

elements.label: Fissifer, The Pioneer of Steel (Charging)
elements.description: A dazzling and unbound flame, breaking free from the constraints of worldly logics. Soon, he would break through the invisible wall of the Mansus, etching the names of steel and fire into the histories.

elements.label: Fissifer, The Pioneer of Steel (Rekindling)
elements.description: Fissifer is recovering his light and heat at an astonishing rate.

elements.label: Blazlings
elements.description: A blazing, unstable spirit exists solely to rush towards a designated target at a certain moment, and then detonate in a suicide explosion - very beautiful, and quite cost-effective.

elements.label: Dazlings
elements.description: A bright, unstable spirit exists solely to release its own light at a certain moment, until it completely exhausted itself - very beautiful, and quite cost-effective.

elements.label: Meet With The Caccia's Leader?
elements.description: Why did the Cross warriors appear on this side of history at this time? And why didn't they, like most Moth beings, target me as their prey? The Red Grail and the Moth, the two Hours from the Wood, did they once again have a conflict? There's a lot about this battle, that I can't understand for now. Perhaps there are indeed some convincing reasons behind it.

elements.label: Seal of the Caccia
elements.description: A crude token made of crustacean material, engraved with ancient incantations that cannot be expressed through waking language. If I touch these incantations and silently recite the true name of the Caccia's leader in my mind, my new ally will arrive and support me in the battle.

elements.label: Seal of the Caccia
elements.description: A crude token made of crustacean material, engraved with ancient incantations that cannot be expressed through waking language. If I touch these incantations and silently recite the true name of the Caccia's leader in my mind, my new ally will arrive and support me in the battle.

elements.label: Seal of the Caccia
elements.description: A crude token made of crustacean material, engraved with ancient incantations that cannot be expressed through waking language. If I touch these incantations and silently recite the true name of the Caccia's leader in my mind, my new ally will arrive and support me in the battle.

elements.label: Elb, The Skin Hunter
elements.description: Seven transformations, seven rebirths. Throughout its long life, this Skinstealer has been dedicated to achieving a state of total liberation and chaos. And the impending great battle has only made him more delusional - perhaps this passion will eventually become too intense and force me to extinguish it, but for now I still need to utilize its power.

elements.label: Elb, Preparing to Strike
elements.description: Sharpening the claws, spreading the wings - Elb is preparing for the next hunt.

elements.label: Elb, Traceless
elements.description:
Elb quietly vanished, disappearing into the shadowy recesses of the Woods.
[This ally is unable to fight, until next time you summoned him.]

elements.label: The Rising Guards Party
elements.description: 'The wings to Glory rising', is the most noble branch of the Cross bloodline, according to some. This claim cannot be verified at present, but in reality, these shiny large creatures are quite gentle and patient, and are well-versed in how to control enemies and protect their allies.

elements.label: The Rising Guards Party (Resting)
elements.description: Claws collide, shells rustle - the giants of the Carapace Cross are keeping watch for their companions in their own distinctive way.

elements.label: The Flickering Breachers Party
elements.description: Spawn of the Moth, favourlings of the Grail, and the descendants of the first hunters in the Woods. These swift hunters can deceive their enemies with their skills and launch assaults at astonishing speeds, leaving only shimmering trails of light in their wake. Elegant and deadly.

elements.label: The Flickering Breachers Party (Resting)
elements.description: The wings of the ancient warriors are sometimes bright and then dim. They needed to rest in order to regain their astonishing speed again.

elements.label: Tricky Scouting Party
elements.description: These creatures are the most cunning and agile ones of the Carapace-kinds, possessing the skills of gathering information and concealing itself. It is not difficult to understand why they serve as the ears and eyes of this group.

elements.label: Tricky Scouting Party (Resting)
elements.description: The good news is that it seems these troublemakers haven't been so bold as to actually carry out their pranks on me. The bad news is that just listening to the buzzing sounds they make while communicating is already quite annoying.

elements.label: Meet With The Legion's Leader?
elements.description: In the ancient and chaotic Bounds, the Owl and the Lion jointly guard the gate leading to Mansus. This is a fact that we all know. Then, why are the gate-guard warriors under the Fourfold Lion's command engaged in battle with the Knot's army here? Has the pact between the two-headed axe and the lion craftsman been broken? There are many aspects of this battle that I cannot understand for the moment. Perhaps there are indeed some convincing reasons behind it all.

elements.label: Seal of the Fourfold Lion
elements.description: A small metallic emblem, carved in the shape of a beautiful lion's head. When heat is applied to one of them, the other one that is bound to it will also heat up. The legion soldiers under the command of the Lionsmith will use this for simple long-distance communication.

elements.label: Seal of the Fourfold Lion
elements.description: A small metallic emblem, carved in the shape of a beautiful lion's head. When heat is applied to one of them, the other one that is bound to it will also heat up. The legion soldiers under the command of the Lionsmith will use this for simple long-distance communication.

elements.label: Seal of the Fourfold Lion
elements.description: A small metallic emblem, carved in the shape of a beautiful lion's head. When heat is applied to one of them, the other one that is bound to it will also heat up. The legion soldiers under the command of the Lionsmith will use this for simple long-distance communication.

elements.label: Isolde, the Proterant
elements.description: An Edge-Long, a disciple of the Golden General, also the leader of the Légion du Seuil under his command. For an immortal who takes resistance as her duty, her style is rather young and rash. It is hoped that this current war will teach her how to avoid unnecessarily provoking others.

elements.label: Isolde, Ready for Another
elements.description: Isolde hummed as she quickly cleaned her tools for killing. It seems that she is very much looking forward to performing her duties again.

elements.label: Isolde, Retreated
elements.description:
Isolde reluctantly stepped back, gritting her teeth, re-evaluating the situation.
[This ally is unable to fight, until next time you summoned her.]

elements.label: Monster Riders Squad
elements.description: The mortal body is vulnerable in the presence of monsters - that is why wise warriors also draw upon the power of the monsters to fulfill their duties.

elements.label: Monster Riders Squad (Resting)
elements.description: So glad that I don't have to pay for the monster's parts and feed.

elements.label: Invisible Arts Unit
elements.description: A special operations unit led by adepts who possess lethal skills. The dissemination of knowledge is strictly restricted in the Wake, but this does not apply to those who are struggling fiercely in the lawless regions.

elements.label: Invisible Arts Unit (Resting)
elements.description: The adepts are undergoing necessary rest and recuperation to ensure that they can once again bring forth their lethal skills when needed.

elements.label: Border Field Medics
elements.description: A medical team composed of doctors, surgeons, nurses, and - of course - adepts. They have undergone rigorous training and are well-versed in how to adapt to harsh environments and carry out rescue operations in extreme conditions.

elements.label: Border Field Medics (Restocking)
elements.description: The medics are sorting out and counting the supplies, preparing to face the next challenge of the war.
